model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the loss values across a range of iterations for different models. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", has a linear scale with a value range of approximately 2.4 to 3.4 and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 140,000 and tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The plot contains six lines, each representing a different model: Vanilla (blue, solid, no markers), StrmLLM (n=64) (teal, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid, no markers), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid, no markers), and SepLLM (n=128) (purple, solid, no markers). The lines start at approximately 3.35 for Vanilla and 3.3 for the others at 0 iterations and decrease to approximately 2.55 for all models at 140,000 iterations, with all lines showing a sharp decline in loss in the initial 20,000 iterations, followed by a steady trend.
